summary: Routine installed-system maintenance verification; repositories are current and no repair was required.
changes: Refreshed isolated repository-check metadata and recorded maintenance evidence. No packages, services, desktop settings, jobs, driver policies or security settings changed. Existing customized desktop appearance was preserved; a preference discrepancy was recorded for local review.
tests: ChatGPT OAuth prerequisite passed. Fresh repository check returned up_to_date (exit 2). Package database consistency passed before and after. Registered file-presence checks found no missing files in selected kernel, graphics, desktop, ChatGPT and gaming packages. No failed system or current-user units. Fifteen selected configuration fingerprints remained unchanged. Intel and AMD devices were bound to their existing kernel drivers. Maintenance timer remained enabled and active at thirty-minute intervals with unlimited service start timeout. Optional Wine components and absent X11 session directory were exploratory observations without an observed application failure. No runtime application or performance benchmark was executed.
rollback: No package or configuration rollback required; system configuration was unchanged. The existing maintenance service can be stopped and its timer disabled through the documented systemd controls.
problem: No reproducible distribution defect was identified by the executed checks.
solution: Retained the working installed state and existing user customizations.
reproduction: Routine package database, file-presence, repository availability, driver-binding, configuration fingerprint and systemd state checks.
